sql.customFieldGroupAssignment.archiveRows: update flow.custom_field_group_assignment set archived = true where custom_field_id = :fieldId
sql.customFieldGroupAssignment.getOne: select cfg.*, ot.object_type, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(customFields))) FROM ( SELECT cfga.id, cfga.custom_field_group_id as "customFieldGroupId", cfga.custom_field_id as "customFieldId", cfga.ancillary_custom_field_group_assignment_id as "ancillaryCustomFieldGroupAssignmentId", cfga.field_order as "fieldOrder", cfga.archived, cf.field_name as "fieldName", cfot.id as "customFieldObjectTypeId", cfot.show_on_insert as "showOnInsert" FROM flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga inner join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga.custom_field_id inner join flow.custom_field_object_type cfot on cfot.custom_field_id = cf.id WHERE cfga.custom_field_group_id = cfg.id AND cfga.archived is not true) customFields), '[]') AS "customFields" from flow.custom_field_group cfg inner join flow.object_type ot on ot.id = cfg.object_type_id where cfg.id = :id
sql.customFieldGroupAssignment.getByObjectTy: select cfg.*, cfg.group_name as original_group_name, ot.object_type, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(customFields))) FROM ( SELECT cfga.id, cfga.custom_field_group_id as "customFieldGroupId", cfga.custom_field_id as "customFieldId", cfga.ancillary_custom_field_group_assignment_id as "ancillaryCustomFieldGroupAssignmentId", cfga.field_order as "fieldOrder", cfga.archived, cf.field_name as "fieldName", cfot.id as "customFieldObjectTypeId", cfot.show_on_insert as "showOnInsert" FROM flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga inner join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga.custom_field_id inner join flow.custom_field_object_type cfot on cfot.custom_field_id = cf.id WHERE cfga.custom_field_group_id = cfg.id AND cfga.archived is not true AND cfot.archived is not true ORDER BY cfga.field_order) customFields), '[]') AS "customFields" from flow.custom_field_group cfg inner join flow.object_type ot on ot.id = cfg.object_type_id where ot.id = :objectTypeId and cfg.archived is not true order by cfg.group_order, cfg.group_name
sql.customFieldGroupAssignment.getCustomFiel: select cfga.*, cfg.group_name, cf.field_name, cf.company_data_type_id, cf.date_created, cf.created_by_id, cf.modified_by_id, cf.date_modified from flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga inner join flow.custom_field_group cfg on cfg.id = cfga.custom_field_group_id inner join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga.custom_field_id where cfg.id = :groupId and cfga.archived is not true and cf.archived is not true order by cfga.field_order
sql.customFieldGroupAssignment.getAvailableC: select cf.id,cf.field_name, cfot.object_type_id from flow.custom_field_object_type cfot inner join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfot.custom_field_id where cfot.object_type_id = :objectTypeId and cfot.archived is not true except select cf.id,cf.field_name, cfg.object_type_id from flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga inner join flow.custom_field_group cfg on cfg.id = cfga.custom_field_group_id inner join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga.custom_field_id where cfg.object_type_id = :objectTypeId and cfga.archived is not true order by field_name
sql.customFieldGroupAssignment.getAvailableN: select cf.id,cf.field_name, cfot.object_type_id from flow.custom_field_object_type cfot inner join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfot.custom_field_id where cfot.object_type_id = :objectTypeId and cfot.archived is not true except select cf.id,cf.field_name, cfg.object_type_id from flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga inner join flow.custom_field_group cfg on cfg.id = cfga.custom_field_group_id inner join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga.custom_field_id where cfg.object_type_id = :objectTypeId and cfg.process_step_id = :processStepId and cfga.archived is not true order by field_name
sql.customFieldGroupAssignment.getCustomFiel: SELECT cfga.id, cfga.custom_field_group_id as "customFieldGroupId", cfga.custom_field_id as "customFieldId", cfga.ancillary_custom_field_group_assignment_id as "ancillaryCustomFieldGroupAssignmentId", cfga.field_order as "fieldOrder", cfga.archived, cf.field_name as "fieldName" FROM flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga inner join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga.custom_field_id WHERE cfga.id = :id union all SELECT cfga.id, cfga.custom_field_group_id as "customFieldGroupId", cfga.custom_field_id as "customFieldId", cfga.ancillary_custom_field_group_assignment_id as "ancillaryCustomFieldGroupAssignmentId", cfga.field_order as "fieldOrder", cfga.archived, cf.field_name as "fieldName" FROM flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga inner join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga2 on cfga2.id = cfga.ancillary_custom_field_group_assignment_id inner join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga2.custom_field_id WHERE cfga.id = :id
sql.customFieldGroupAssignment.addFieldToGro: insert into flow.custom_field_group_assignment(custom_field_group_id, custom_field_id, ancillary_custom_field_group_assignment_id, field_order, created_by_id) values (:customFieldGroupId, :customFieldId, :ancillaryCustomFieldGroupAssignmentId, :fieldOrder, :createdById)
sql.customFieldGroupAssignment.updateFieldIn: update flow.custom_field_group_assignment set field_order = :fieldOrder, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :modifiedById where id = :id
sql.customFieldGroupAssignment.deleteFieldFr: update flow.custom_field_group_assignment set archived = true, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :modifiedById where id = :id
sql.customFieldGroupAssignment.deleteAllFiel: update flow.custom_field_group_assignment set archived = true, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :modifiedById where custom_field_group_id = :id
